name: get-things-done
description: Turn messy intent into executable work models with explicit decisions, next actions, and verifiable completion.

interface.shortDescription: Turn fuzzy ideas into executable work
interface.longDescription: Get Things Done helps Claude convert unclear or incomplete intent into an explicit work model: facts, assumptions, decisions, blockers, scope, success criteria, a next executable action, and evidence-backed completion. Works across 9 domain packs: software, product, research, marketing, advisory, data/AI, design/UX, operations, and legal/compliance.
